rules.title: Utilities first
rules.text: Style with utility classes; extract components rather than long @apply blocks.

rules.title: Theme tokens
rules.text: Define colors, spacing and fonts in the Tailwind theme and use them instead of arbitrary values.

rules.title: Class ordering
rules.text: Keep utility classes in the order enforced by the Prettier Tailwind plugin.

rules.title: Responsive and state variants
rules.text: Use responsive, dark and state variants instead of custom media queries.
